{{nonlemma}}

====Verb====

===Etymology 2===

====Adjective====
{{en-adj}}

# {{lb|en|informal|idiomatic}} [[frustrate|Frustrated]], [[annoyed]], or [[tired]], to the [[limit]] of one's [[endurance]], especially by something that one has experienced for too long. {{+obj|en|:with/:of<q:British English>}}
#: {{ux|en|After two days, I am '''fed up''' with this nonsense.}}
#: {{ux|en|I am '''fed up''' watching football on TV.}}
